questions.question: Describe the advantages and limitations of ESP32 Wi-Fi networking compared to other IoT connectivity options.
questions.solution_html:
• networking compared to other IoT connectivity options. table/points 6
  • Compare ESP32 Wi-Fi with ZigBee, LoRa, Bluetooth; cover Evaluation 4
  • speed, range, power, cost, applications; discuss pros &
  • cons.
  • Typical answer
  • The ESP32 is a dual-core microcontroller with built-in Wi-Fi
  • and Bluetooth, widely used in IoT systems for its speed and
  • flexibility. It enables fast data transfer up to 150 Mbps
  • making it ideal for smart homes, monitoring dashboards
  • and automation projects requiring real-time connectivity.
  • Compared with other technologies, ESP32 Wi-Fi provides
  • higher data rates than Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) or
  • ZigBee, though it consumes more power. LoRa, in contrast
  • covers several kilometers but offers very low data speed
  • making it suitable for long-range environmental sensing.
  • The advantages of ESP32 Wi-Fi include its integrated
  • wireless hardware, easy Internet connectivity through a full
  • TCP/IP stack, and strong developer support. However, it
  • consumes more power and has a limited indoor range of
  • around 30–50 m. Network congestion in the 2.4 GHz band
  • may also affect performance. Overall, ESP32 Wi-Fi is ideal
  • for medium-range IoT applications that demand high-speed
  • reliable data transfer, whereas BLE, ZigBee, or LoRa are
  • better suited for low-power or long-distance use.
questions.final_answer: better suited for low-power or long-distance use

  • consumes more power and has a limited indoor range of
  • around 30–50 m. Network congestion in the 2.4 GHz band
  • may also affect performance. Overall, ESP32 Wi-Fi is ideal
  • for medium-range IoT applications that demand high-speed
  • reliable data transfer, whereas BLE, ZigBee, or LoRa are
  • better suited for low-power or long-distance use.
questions.final_answer: better suited for low-power or long-distance use
